ammonia.reason: Ammonia from amino acid deamination by surface Brevibacterium/Corynebacterium raising rind pH.

animal_barnyard.reason: p-cresol/indole/isovaleric from smear coryneforms and extensive protein/lipid breakdown.

bitter.reason: Hydrophobic peptides from proteolysis, partly degraded by smear peptidases limiting bitterness.

blue_moldy.reason: Trace heptan-2-one/nonan-2-one from fatty acid beta-oxidation, no Penicillium roqueforti inoculation.

browning.reason: Reducing sugars depleted but free amino acids allow moderate Maillard on heating.

buttery.reason: Diacetyl/acetoin from citrate fermentation by Lc. diacetylactis/Leuconostoc, partly masked by smear sulfur.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: High butyric and 3-methylbutanoic acids from lipolysis and Brevibacterium leucine catabolism.

creaminess.reason: 26% fat at ~45% FDM and proteolysed protein matrix giving smooth creamy mouthfeel.

crumbliness.reason: Deacidified elastic paste with no dry granular structure; deforms rather than fractures.

firmness.reason: High-moisture rennet gel with smear-softened paste; supple and spoonable when ripe.

floral_honey.reason: Low 2-phenylethanol/phenylacetaldehyde from phenylalanine catabolism by surface yeasts.

fruity.reason: Ethyl butanoate/hexanoate from yeast/Brevibacterium esterification of free fatty acids with ethanol.

goaty.reason: Low-medium C6-C8 free fatty acids from cow-milk lipolysis, no goat-milk fatty acid excess.

malty_nutty.reason: Low Strecker 2-/3-methylbutanal from leucine/isoleucine catabolism during proteolysis.

melt.reason: De-mineralized high-pH proteolysed casein network flows readily on heating like Limburger.

mushroom_earthy.reason: Trace 1-octen-3-ol from linoleic acid oxidation, suppressed by dominant smear volatiles.

oil_off.reason: Moderate free fat release on melting from soft high-moisture 26% fat matrix.

smoky.reason: No smoking step and no guaiacol formation in washed-rind make.

sour_vinegar.reason: Lactic/acetic acids largely deacidified by Debaryomyces/Brevibacterium surface metabolism.

stretch.reason: No pasta-filata acid-stretching; rennet curd has no aligned casein for stringing.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Methanethiol/DMDS/DMTS from Brevibacterium linens methionine demethiolation in smear.

sweet.reason: Residual lactose fully fermented; salt and acids suppress sweetness perception.

umami.reason: High glutamate and small peptides from rennet plus smear proteolysis during 6-8 week ripening.
